# Set up environment
```{r dependencies, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Change this to your directory
.libPaths("/ref/jdlab/software/r-envs/simona/r-packages/4.2/")

# Load dependencies
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(scCustomize)

set.seed(420)

source("../color_utils.R")
```

# Load in preprocessed data
```{r load}
combined_neuronal_annotated <- readRDS("../../data/250321_combined_neuronal_annotated.rds")
combined_neuronal_annotated
```
You should have a seurat object wiht 37462 features across 124601 nuclei.

# Sample annotation table
```{r sample annotation table by sample}
# Get the necessary columns from the Seurat object metadata
# First, select only one row per sample to avoid duplicates
sample_info <- combined_neuronal_annotated@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    # Core information
    sample,
    orig.ident,
    genotype,
    sex,
    Coded_ID.x,

    # Quality metrics - will be summarized per sample
    nCount_RNA,
    nFeature_RNA,
    percent_mito,
    percent_ribo,
    doublet,

    # Cell type information
    cell_type,
    ABC_class_name,
    ABC_subclass_name,

    # Experimental variables
    Ever_Learner,
    Avg_Test_Distance,
    Avg_Total_Rewards,
    Sac_Test_Distance,
    Sac_Total_Rewards
  )

# Create a summary table with one row per sample
sample_summary <- sample_info %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarize(
    # Core information (take the first value as these should be the same for all cells in a sample)
    genotype = dplyr::first(genotype),
    sex = dplyr::first(sex),
    Coded_ID = dplyr::first(Coded_ID.x),

    # Quality metrics (calculate means per sample)
    mean_nCount_RNA = mean(nCount_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nFeature_RNA = mean(nFeature_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percent_mito = mean(percent_mito, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percent_ribo = mean(percent_ribo, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),

    # Cell type percentages (calculate the proportion of each cell type)
    total_nuclei = n(),

    # Experimental variables (take the first value as these should be constant per sample)
    Ever_Learner = dplyr::first(Ever_Learner),
    Avg_Test_Distance = dplyr::first(Avg_Test_Distance),
    Avg_Total_Rewards = dplyr::first(Avg_Total_Rewards),
    Sac_Test_Distance = dplyr::first(Sac_Test_Distance),
    Sac_Total_Rewards = dplyr::first(Sac_Total_Rewards)
  )

# Add additional technical information needed for GEO
geo_annotation <- sample_summary %>%
  mutate(
    organism = "Mus musculus",
    sequencing_platform = "Illumina NovaSeq X Plus",
    library_protocol = "ScaleBio Single Cell RNA Sequencing Kit",
    tissue = "Brain",
    brain_region = "tuberal hypothalamus and thalamus"
  )


# Preview the table
head(geo_annotation)

# Write to CSV file
write.csv(geo_annotation, "../../results/neuronal_processing/250324_snRNAseq_GEO_annotation_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Code to generate cell-level metadata supplemental table

# Extract cell-level metadata
cell_metadata <- combined_neuronal_annotated@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    # Core information
    sample,
    genotype,
    sex,
    Coded_ID.x,

    # Cell-specific quality metrics
    nCount_RNA,
    nFeature_RNA,
    percent_mito,
    percent_ribo,

    # Clustering information
    RNA_snn_res.1.8,

    # Cell type information
    cell_type,
    ABC_class_name,
    ABC_subclass_name,
    ABC_supertype_name,
    hypomap_prediction_probability,
    hypomap_predicted,

    # Experimental variables
    Ever_Learner,
    Avg_Test_Distance,
    Avg_Total_Rewards,
    Sac_Test_Distance,
    Sac_Total_Rewards
  )

# Add a unique cell identifier
cell_metadata <- cell_metadata %>%
  mutate(
    cell_id = rownames(combined_neuronal_annotated@meta.data),
    organism = "Mus musculus",
    brain_region = "tuberal hypothalamus and thalamus",
    sequencing_platform = "Illumina NovaSeq X Plus",
    library_protocol = "ScaleBio Single Cell RNA Sequencing Kit"
  )

write.csv(cell_metadata, "../../results/neuronal_processing/250324_snRNAseq_cell_metadata.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Preview the table
head(cell_metadata)
```
